dataset.citation: Karim et al., Sci. Rep. 11 (2021) 7628 (CardioTox net); dataset via Therapeutics Data Commons (hERG_Karim)
dataset.description: hERG channel blockade calls assembled by Karim et al. from patch-clamp and fluorescence-based screens; a compound is labelled a blocker at IC50 < 10 uM.
dataset.endpoint: probability that the compound blocks hERG at IC50 < 10 uM
dataset.name: herg_blockade

label: hERG blockade (QSAR)
metric_summary: Scaffold-split held-out ROC-AUC 0.86, balanced accuracy 0.77, Brier score 0.15 on 2689 compounds sharing no scaffold with the training set.

split.method: Bemis-Murcko scaffold split (largest scaffold groups held for training)
